**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 21:01
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Introducing Seafood Laksa - A Spicy and Delicious Soup.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The recipe explores how to make a bowl of seafood laksa that combines fragrant spices, succulent seafood, and creamy coconut milk.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The seafood laksa can be prepared in less than 30 minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To prepare the laksa paste, heat three tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add a peeled and chopped onion and cook for five to six minutes until it softens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add four medium red chilies, two teaspoons of ginger paste, two minced cloves of garlic, a teaspoon of lemongrass paste, a tablespoon of fresh coriander stalks, a teaspoon and a half of turmeric, half a teaspoon each of cumin and paprika, and a teaspoon of tamarind paste.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mix all the ingredients together and fry for another five minutes until they release a lovely fragrance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Transfer the mixture to a mini chopper and blend it to form a paste.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prepare a garnish by mixing a teaspoon of rice vinegar, a teaspoon of caster sugar, finely chopped red chili, a finger-sized piece of finely chopped cucumber, a quarter of a small finely diced red onion, and a small handful of chopped coriander leaf.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Combine the garnish ingredients until well-mixed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add the laksa paste back into the frying pan with 200 mL of full-fat coconut milk, a teaspoon of fish sauce, and 300 mL of chicken or seafood stock.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Stir the ingredients together and bring to a gentle simmer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add two cod or haddock fillets weighing about 140 grams or five ounces each and cook for about four minutes until the fish starts to flake apart.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Soak 200 grams or about seven ounces of dried rice or vermicelli noodles in boiling water for about three minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add 16 king prawns to serve four people and cook for another minute until they turn pink.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add 200 grams or about seven ounces of fresh bean sprouts and cook for another minute or two until heated through.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To serve, drain the rice noodles and divide them between four bowls, topping with the seafood laksa and a tablespoon of
